Title: General availability: Lucene query syntax in Azure Search

Body.Content: The Lucene query syntax is now generally available as part of the 2015-02-28 version of the Azure Search REST API. The public preview of the feature was recently announced in this blog post: Lucene query language in Azure Search. You can find the full documentation on MSDN: Lucene query syntax in Azure Search.
Body.Markdown:
The Lucene query syntax is now generally available as part of the 2015-02-28 version of the Azure Search REST API.

The public preview of the feature was recently announced in this blog post: Lucene query language in Azure Search .

You can find the full documentation on MSDN: Lucene query syntax in Azure Search .
